text: Landed; ticket was never closed. manifest.scala carries thin v2 SourceManifest (private ctor, companion-only), the ENUMERABLE ArtifactStore (list + bytes), VerifiedArtifact with private payload and byteAt/iterator/toArray, Verified, VerificationFailure, Verify.verify. The two aliasing routes are SEPARATE tests plus a third for the stdlib route. Forge probe out of package in storymodel4s.consumer.CorpusCarrierProbeSuite.
